name: Burpee

phases.name: squat
phases.cue: Squat down and plant your hands

phases.name: jump back
phases.cue: Jump your feet back to a plank

phases.name: jump in
phases.cue: Jump your feet in to your hands

formTips: Plant your hands just in front of your feet
Land in a straight plank, hips in line with your shoulders
Jump your feet in close to your hands
Land softly with your knees bent
commonMistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank
Landing the feet far from the hands
Rounding the back to reach the floor
